Welcome to the Academy

Quranic education your family can trust — wherever you live

Shia Online Quran Academy is an online Quran teaching academy serving Shia Muslim families in Pakistan and around the world. Every student learns one-to-one with a dedicated teacher, follows a personal learning plan, and progresses step by step — from the first letters of Noorani Qaida to fluent Nazra reading, Tajweed, and memorization of the Holy Quran.

Parents are partners in the journey: weekly reports, attendance records and direct teacher feedback keep you informed about exactly what your child is learning and how they are progressing.

Our Teaching Methodology

How learning happens, step by step

Assess

A free trial class lets the teacher understand the student's current level, reading ability and goals.

Plan

A personal learning plan is set — course, weekly schedule, and clear targets for the term.

Learn

Live one-to-one classes on Google Meet or Zoom, with lesson-by-lesson practice and correction.

Report

Attendance and progress are recorded after every class and shared with parents weekly.

Inside every weekly parent report

Each week, parents receive a written report built from the teacher's real lesson records — this is what it contains:

AttendanceClasses scheduled, attended & missed, with percentage
Lessons completedWhat was covered in class during the week
Reading progressCurrent Para, Surah & reading position
Tajweed developmentPronunciation focus & areas improving
HomeworkWhat was set, what was completed, what is due
Teacher feedbackBehaviour, attention, participation & strengths
Next targetsThe learning goals set for the coming week

See a sample report in the Parent Portal →

The Student Learning Journey

From the first letter to a lifelong connection with the Quran

1. Free trial & level check — meet the teacher and find the right starting point.
2. Noorani Qaida foundations — letters, sounds and joining, the base of all reading.
3. Nazra Quran reading — reading the Holy Quran fluently, Para by Para.
4. Tajweed refinement — correct pronunciation and the rules of beautiful recitation.
5. Hifz & Islamic studies — memorization with a revision system, alongside Duas, Ziyarat and character education.

About Our Academy

An academy built on trust, care and the love of the Holy Quran

Shia Online Quran Academy provides online Quran teaching and Islamic education for children, teenagers and adults. Based in Faisalabad, Pakistan, and teaching students across the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia and worldwide, the academy exists for one purpose: to help every student build a strong, lasting connection with the Holy Quran.

We know that for families living abroad, finding a reliable Quran teacher who understands Shia Islamic education — and who reports honestly on a child's progress — can be difficult. That is why our academy is built on structure and transparency: personal learning plans, recorded attendance, weekly parent reports, and open communication with teachers and administration.

Classes are one-to-one and live, held on Google Meet or Zoom at times that suit each family's time zone. Students progress through a clear curriculum — Noorani Qaida, Nazra Quran, Tajweed, Hifz, Islamic Studies, Duas and Ziyarat, and moral and character education — at a pace that is right for them.

Frequently Asked Questions

Questions families ask us

How do online classes work?

Classes are live and one-to-one on Google Meet or Zoom. The student joins from any phone, tablet or computer; the teacher shares the lesson, listens to the student's reading, corrects pronunciation, and records progress after every class.

Which countries and time zones do you teach in?

We teach worldwide, including the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and Pakistan. The academy is open 24 hours, every day, and class times are arranged around your local time zone and family routine.

What does the free trial class include?

The trial is a real class with a teacher: your child's level is assessed, you experience how online learning works, and you receive a recommended course and learning plan. There is no obligation to enroll afterwards.

My child has never read Arabic. Where do they start?

With Noorani Qaida — the foundation course that teaches letters, sounds and joining step by step. Most beginners then move to Basic Quran Reading and Nazra Quran.

How will I know how my child is progressing?

Through the Parent Portal and weekly reports: attendance, lessons completed, reading and Tajweed development, homework, teacher feedback, and next learning targets — all based on real recorded lessons.

Do you teach adults as well as children?

Yes. Children, teenagers and adults all learn with us, including adults beginning from Qaida or returning to improve Tajweed and fluency.

What is included in Shia Islamic education?

Age-appropriate teaching of essential beliefs and worship, Duas and Ziyarat, and the moral and character teachings of the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.w.) and the Ahlul Bayt (a.s.), taught by teachers from reliable sources.

How is attendance recorded?

Attendance is marked and verified by the teacher for every class (Present, Absent, Late, Excused or Rescheduled) with joining and ending times. Simply clicking a join link never counts as attendance on its own.

How do I register or ask a question?

Use the registration form, message us on WhatsApp at +92 307 4348899, or send a message through the contact page.

Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Shia Online Quran Academy respects the privacy of students, parents and teachers, and handles personal information responsibly.

Information we collect

We collect only the information needed to run classes: student and parent names, age, country and city, contact details (email and WhatsApp number), course and level information, class schedules, attendance, and teacher progress records.

How we use it

Information is used to arrange classes, communicate with parents, record attendance and progress, and provide weekly reports. We do not sell personal information, and we never publish a student's name, photograph, report or attendance publicly.

Children's privacy

Accounts for minors are created only with parent or guardian involvement. Parents may view all records held about their own children and may request corrections or deletion at any time.

Access and security

Portal access is role-based: students, parents, teachers and administrators each see only the information relevant to their role. Families can contact the academy on WhatsApp at +92 307 4348899 with any privacy question or request.

Updates

This policy may be updated as the academy's platform develops; the current version will always be shown on this page.

Terms & Conditions

Terms and Conditions

Our service

Shia Online Quran Academy provides live online Quran and Islamic education classes for children, teenagers and adults. Classes are held one-to-one on Google Meet or Zoom at agreed times.

Registration and trial classes

Submitting a registration or trial request does not by itself create an account. The academy office confirms each registration, agrees the schedule with the parent, and then issues portal access.

Attendance and rescheduling

Attendance is recorded by the teacher for every scheduled class. Families are asked to inform the academy in advance if a class cannot be attended, so it can be marked Excused or Rescheduled fairly.

Conduct

Students, parents and teachers are expected to treat one another with respect during classes and communications. The academy may pause classes where this standard is not met, after discussing the matter with the family.

Learning materials

Materials in the library and portal are provided for enrolled students' personal learning. Religious content is taught from reliable sources and verified by teachers; nothing on this website constitutes a religious ruling (fatwa).

Contact

Questions about these terms can be sent through the contact page or on WhatsApp at +92 307 4348899.
